text:
Sam: Starting rollout approval for v0.9.3 to prod (us-west + eu-central). Need a final signoff on the prompt/eval gating matrix before we go. Quick status? :eyes:

Maria: Change window booked 18:00-20:00 PT today. Ops asked for QA+ML signoff by 16:00 PT otherwise we shift to tomorrow.

Lee: Paste from the latest eval run:
```
eval_suite: summarizer_regression_v3
samples: 1500
metric: ROUGE-L
baseline (prod v0.9.2): 0.488
candidate (v0.9.3): 0.482 (-1.2%)
regression_buckets: longform=1.8%, short=0.3%
safety: 0 fails, 2 warns
quality_gate: FAIL (threshold -1.0%)
```

Anya: That -1.2% breaches gate. The policy says hold + ML lead + QA decision for exception or pin. Sam, do we want an exception or a temporary pin?

Sam: Prefer to avoid full rollback in-window. Two options: 1) split-route pin: pin high-volume mobile route to v0.9.2-q and push v0.9.3 to lower-traffic routes; 2) pin everything to v0.9.2 until bisect complete. Ops, can we do split-route config change during the window?

Taylor: Ops: split-route pin is doable. We can flip routing at 18:05 PT and keep 10% progressive canary for candidate on non-pinned routes. We'll need release lead manual override to bypass the eval gate for canary.

DeployBot: deploybot detected: preflight eval gate FAILED for v0.9.3. Full rollout blocked. Canary allowed only with manual override by release lead. Reminder: attach justification in release PR if override used.

Lee: I propose pinning the heavy mobile summarizer route (route: /v1/summarize/mobile) to v0.9.2-q and letting v0.9.3 serve web/longform routes at 10% canary. That isolates the regression impact.

Anya: I'll run a narrowed bisect on the top 40 failing prompts (by delta magnitude) and check for prompt pattern (length, presence of code blocks, list prompts). Will post grouped examples in ~35m.

Maria: QA: we'll run the smoke harness on the canary once traffic is routed. Required checks: 20 sample prompts, latency P95 < 300ms, content sanity (no hallucination spikes). Ready to start when you give green.

Lee: Also doing a quick kernel/attn-profile to confirm no perf regression from quant changes. If perf drop exists it could explain quality loss on long sequences.

Sam: Action list: (1) Anya bisect and post findings (~35m). (2) Lee perf/accuracy diff between v0.9.3 and v0.9.2-q. (3) QA to run smoke on canary when routed. (4) Ops to prepare split-route pin config. We'll pin only if ML+QA advise. React with :white_check_mark: against your item.

Maria: ✅ coordinating QA schedule.

Lee: ✅ starting perf/acc diff.

Anya: ✅ starting bisect now, will report back with a short table of failing prompts and suspected root causes.

DeployBot: note: add release notes entry explaining temporary split-route pin and rationale, link to eval artifacts and bisect ticket (#INC-4512).

Sam: I'll add the blurb to the PR and link the runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/eval-gate. Reconfirm here once bisect & diff are in.

QA_Bot: QA checklist ready: smoke_samples=20, latency_assert=300ms, correctness_sample_review=5. Will post results to thread after canary is live.

Sam: Holding decision until reports. If we don't have ML+QA signoff by 16:00 PT, schedule will move. Manual override path is available but needs explicit consent from release lead + product.

Lee: ETA for my diff ~25m. If bisect shows prompt-format sensitivity, we can also consider a prompt-normalization shim as a short-term mitigation.

Anya: Back in 32m with initial bisect results. Early signal points to list-heavy inputs and trailing punctuation causing lower ROUGE-L on long sequences.

Sam: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene at 15:50 PT here to decide pin vs canary.
